source_evidence: Day327~16:15 exact player 'Yeah' in response to Cirren's recommendation to brief Desen first about the afternoon findings and Harthvale approach. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar make ordinary walk together to established Western District Watch annex, meet Sgt Rill Desen and provide candid factual report of Sallow's personal admissions, signed referral, Harthvale's identification as head of the joint freight association and pending introduction request, Tavosk's personal acknowledgment and six-gold offer, actual V payment and generic signed receipt, and pending Copper Hart delivery of a single advance inspection notice. All three companions independently confirm witnessed statements and transaction; no fabricated V quotations or sworn deposition, no new roll, spending, promise, arrest, legal immunity or transfer of original documents. V retains Sallow referral and Tavosk receipt and handwritten notes. Desen records report, acknowledges payment went beyond his earlier advice, says 'You've given me something I can take to the customs examiner. No more money changes hands without talking to me first. If the notice comes, preserve it. As for Harthvale, I want to know what he personally authorized, not simply whose name is on the account.' He will use available evidence to seek appropriate authority for securing records and corroborating the warnings, not wait idly for V or guarantee a warrant, seizure or arrest. He asks to make faithful copies of the two new papers, allowing V to retain originals because Sallow referral may still have utility. No copying or surrender yet; V decides consent. Desen now knows actual afternoon facts and paid commission, not hidden prep or any confirmed additional contraband/murder involvement. Harthvale invitation and advance warning still pending; no actual receipt of either. All resources unchanged except elapsed ordinary time. Await V response.
